outcome: Neonatal receptor activator of nuclear factor kB ligand (RANKL) serum concentrations
cohort: The study included 28 premature newborns of mothers with early-onset pre-eclampsia, 28 preterm neonates of normotensive mothers, and 28 full-term neonates of normotensive mothers.
finding: Neonates of pre-eclamptic mothers had higher OPG and lower RANKL levels compared to both control groups, and pre-eclampsia was an independent predictor of increased diastolic and mean blood pressure in these neonates.
birth_weight: Birth weight z-score was measured as a determinant of OPG levels, and the cohort included premature, preterm, and full-term neonates, implying a range of birth weights.
gest_age: The study included both premature/preterm and full-term neonates.
